summary: S. Srikanta Sastri was an Indology and history/archaeology scholar who studied at Maharaja's College, Mysore under M. H. Krishna (~1923–1926). He held a post at the University of Mysore (~1926–1960) and taught T. V. Venkatachala Sastry.

S. Swaminathan is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied under J. Sundaram and served as Deputy Superintending Epigraphist (Retd.) at the Archaeological Survey of India until 2013.

Saba Mahmood was a religious studies scholar who studied at the University of Washington and completed her PhD at Stanford University (~1992–1998). She held posts at the University of Chicago (~1999–2004) and UC Berkeley (2004–2018).

Sabine Klein-Schwind works in Indology and Buddhist studies. She studied under doctoral supervisor Harunaga Isaacson (attested 2026) and is attested in 2026 as a research fellow at the University of Hamburg.

Sabine Löhr is an Indology and philosophy scholar. She studied at the University of Freiburg and the University of Hamburg (M.A.), where she worked as a Wissenschaftliche Hilfskraft and completed doctoral studies under Lambert Schmithausen.
Sabriye Tenberken is a Tibetology scholar who studied at the University of Bonn (~1992–1997) and founded the organization Braille Without Borders.
Saburō Hasegawa studied at the University of Tokyo (~1926–1929). He taught Alan Watts and held posts at the American Academy of Asian Studies and California College of the Arts (~1955–1957).
Sachin Kathale works in computational linguistics and Indology. He earned an M.Phil. from Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2007 and served as a teacher at Samskrita Bharati.

Sadajiro Sugiura studied at Rikkyo University, the University of Pennsylvania (PhD), and Philadelphia Divinity School. He held posts at the University of Pennsylvania, the Army War College (1903), and Rikkyo University (lecturer in 1907; professor emeritus 1931–1932).
Saerji is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology scholar with posts at Peking University, serving as Associate Professor (attested 2010–2016) and faculty member (attested 2026).
Sai Susarla works in computational studies and Indology. He served as Dean at MIT World Peace University (attested 2019) and held a post at the Siddhanta Knowledge Foundation (attested 2025).
Said Reza Huseini is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied at King's College London, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and Leiden University (~2017–2021).

Saiyid Athar Abbas Rizvi studied under Mohammad Habib and graduated from Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University. He held positions at Aligarh Muslim University, SOAS, University of Jammu and Kashmir, JNU, and Australian National University (Reader, 1967–1986).

Sakda Hemthep is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned an MPhil from Cardiff University in 2014, studying under Peter Harvey and supervisor Max Deeg. He is attested as a PhD researcher at Ghent University in 2026.

Sakunoshin Motoda was a religious studies scholar who studied at Kenyon College (~1887–1891), the University of Pennsylvania (~1891–1895), and Columbia University (~1895–1896). He held a post at Rikkyo University from ~1907 to 1928.
Sakutaro Fujioka was a Japanese studies and history scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo (~1894–1897) and later held a post there (~1900–1910).

Sakya Trizin Ngawang Kunga is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar. Trained under teachers including the 14th Dalai Lama, he founded Sakya Centre, Sakya College, and Sakya Institute, and served as abbot at Sakya Monastery until 2017.

Sakyong Mipham studied at Oxford, Namdroling Monastery, and under Chögyam Trungpa, whom he succeeded. Active in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, he served as a board member at Naropa University until 2018.

Sallie B. King is a Buddhist studies and philosophy scholar who studied at the University of British Columbia under Leon Hurvitz. She held a long-term post at James Madison University (~1992–2015), where she became Professor Emerita.

Sally J. Sutherland Goldman completed her PhD at UC Berkeley (1979) under Shivram Dattatray Joshi and T. Shrinivas Shastri. She held posts at UC Berkeley (attested 1996, 2007) and became Senior Lecturer Emerita (attested 2026).
